reason: The company is acquiring an 84.71-acre land parcel in Delhi via a non-cash share swap, which is projected to unlock a Gross Development Value (GDV) of INR 10,000-12,000 crore.
why_now: The board approved the acquisition and the specific GDV potential was disclosed on August 28, 2026.
source_headlines: Max Estates Limited: Max Estates Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 28, 2026 about the Acquisition by Max Estates Limited of Land Owning Companies.
